domain_restrictions: m is an integer (used as the comparison endpoints)
x is real (so the comparisons and floor are defined)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every real number x and every integer m, if m is less than or equal to x and x is strictly less than m plus 1, then the greatest integer less than or equal to x equals m.
quantifier_order: there exist m and x satisfying the premises
for all x and for all m, if the premise holds then the conclusion holds
witness_dependencies: m is a universally quantified parameter determined by the premise; the value floor(x) is forced to equal that same m (no independent existential witness).

statement_nl: Let x be a real number and let m be an integer. If m <= x < m + 1, then floor(x) = m.
